title_en: In the Courtroom (20/20): Mediating a Noise Dispute Between Neighbors
note_en: A 到 after a verb marks that the action actually reaches its target or result: 深夜的噪音影响到了全家人的睡眠 "the late-night noise was getting to the whole family's sleep." English usually builds this into the verb itself (affect, reach, find out), but in Chinese 影响 alone just names the activity, while adding 到 signals that it landed on something. Note that 了 comes after the whole verb + 到 unit: 影响到了, not 影响了到.
